_help: Copy this file to profile/settings.json and fill it in. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Every tool reads this file; nothing personal is written in the code. Check it with: python3 -I tools/kit.py --check

candidate.name: Alex Example
candidate._school_portal: Your university's own job portal, if it has one. Firms that recruit through it may expect you to apply there first; the research shift holds those and asks you.
candidate._program: What you call the placement in your emails: internship, placement, work term, co-op.
candidate._availability: Written exactly as every email must state it, for example: six months, from <month> to <month> <year>
candidate._situation: One line for the email triage prompt: who you are and what you are looking for.
candidate.situation: a student looking for an internship

_timezone: Your own time zone (use your Mac's). The sender hours, the daily cap and every log are in it.
_hours: Sender hours, your time: Mail is touched only from night_start to sender_end; research and other work stop at work_end.

send._mode: prepare = every due email is saved to Mail's Drafts and NOTHING is sent (the default). send = emails with "approved": true are sent; the rest are still only drafted.
send._end_date: Optional YYYY-MM-DD: after this day the night job stops touching Mail.
send._holiday: Optional: follow-ups that would fall between from and to (YYYY-MM-DD) go on resume instead, same local time.

_default_window: Recipient-local send window for a region that names none: weekdays, from the first time to the second.
_regions: Every email names one region. window is recipient-local time. A region whose window never falls inside your sender hours never sends: kit.py --check warns about it. work_rights is the one sentence an email to that region must contain (checked by check_msgs.py); leave it empty for none. spelling: UK, US or empty.

mail._account: The account's name exactly as Mail shows it (Mail > Settings > Accounts), for example iCloud or Work.
mail._from: The sender line. Empty means: candidate.name <candidate.email>.

_writing: Your writing rules. check_msgs.py holds every planned email to them. banned entries are case-insensitive regular expressions.

writing.opt_out_line: If this isn't relevant, just let me know and I won't follow up.

_replies: Suggested answers shown in needs-me.md (never sent) and the thank-you saved to Drafts after a polite no. Per language; {their_name}, {name}, {first_name}, {sign_off}, {availability} are filled in.

audit._my_addresses: Every address you send from, so your own emails are never listed as needing you.

_postings: tools/scan_postings.py: case-insensitive regular expressions for the title, titles to drop, and places.
_jev_dir: Optional: the folder of your jev-job-search copy, so the tracker lists its applications too.
